FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Bloom & Blossom Florists, we specialize in providing high-quality floral arrangements and gifts for all occasions, including weddings, corporate events, and everyday celebrations. Our operations are conducted from our licensed brick-and-mortar location, ensuring compliance with all local regulations. We pride ourselves on exceptional customer service, timely order fulfillment, and maintaining a positive reputation in the community. Our team follows documented risk management procedures for all delivery and event setup activities, ensuring that each floral arrangement is made with fresh flowers sourced from reputable suppliers. We conduct regular risk assessments and safety checks to safeguard our staff and customers, and we continually monitor customer satisfaction metrics to enhance our service offerings. Each offsite setup is preceded by thorough event site safety assessments, guaranteeing safe work conditions. At Bloom & Blossom Florists, we are committed to quality and safety in every aspect of our business operations.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any activities that compromise compliance with local regulations and maintains all necessary licenses. We confirm that event site safety assessments are conducted for all offsite setups, and we strictly prohibit the use of unlicensed pesticides or chemicals. Additionally, formal commercial contracts are established for all aspects of our operations, ensuring complete adherence to industry standards.
